subject: Pre-procurement: IR plan, SIG/CAIQ artifacts and evidence delivery
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@mediscanhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: IR plan + SIG/CAIQ artifacts for pre-procurement review

Vanessa —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. As part of our security and procurement review for the Redwood pilot, Mediscan needs the following artifacts to complete our security questionnaire and legal intake:

- Current Incident Response Plan (IRP) and tabletop run notes (if available)
- Completed SIG Lite/CAIQ crosswalk or a populated CAIQ where applicable
- Evidence manifest (SOC 2 certs or SOC 2 in progress note, SOC auditor contact if available)
- Network diagram (high level) and data flow for PII/PHI handling in hosted vs. private deployments

Can you confirm what you can share by EOD Friday (9/18) and a reasonable ETA for any remaining items? We need to loop in procurement (procurement@mediscanhealth.com) and security for the SOW discussion next week.

If easier, a short call with your security/compliance lead would help — we can do 30 minutes.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Lead InfoSec Analyst, Mediscan Health
Elena.Soto@mediscanhealth.com

[Attachment: Mediscan_RFP_Security_Checklist.xlsx (referenced)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@mediscanhealth.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IR plan + SIG/CAIQ artifacts for pre-procurement review

Elena —

Appreciate the clear list. I'm looping in our security and compliance leads (stephanie, karthik, naomi) to assemble the package. We'll aim to get a core bundle to you today and follow up on any items that need additional redaction or legal review.

Stephanie / Karthik / Naomi — FYI: Mediscan is requesting the IRP, SIG/CAIQ materials, evidence manifest and a high-level dataflow/network diagram. Procurement is targeting SOW next week. Can you confirm:

1) Which artifacts we can share verbatim today?
2) Any items that require redaction or SOC auditor permission?
3) Who can join a 30-minute walkthrough with Mediscan tomorrow if they want a live review?

I'll coordinate delivery and approvals once I have confirmation.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T13:46:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: IR plan + SIG/CAIQ artifacts for pre-procurement review

Vanessa — forwarding status:

Quick answers to your three bullets:
1) Artifacts we can share today (attached): Redwood_IRP_v1.3.pdf (redacted contact emails), SIG_evidence_manifest.xlsx (mapping of evidence to SIG controls), caiq-crosswalk.md (CAIQ fields with guidance).
2) Redactions required: internal hostnames/IPs and SOC auditor workpapers. SOC 2 report is in progress; we can provide a readiness letter instead of the final report.
3) Walkthrough availability: I can join a 30-minute review tomorrow 9/19 between 10–12 PT. Karthik can cover operational questions and Naomi can help on compliance remit.

Delivery plan: I will upload the bundle to a shared Drive folder and email a secure link to the Mediscan contacts. For anything that references auditor workpapers we will provide a statement and propose a vendor-controlled review under NDA if they need deeper access.

Attachments (zipped in Drive):
- Redwood_IRP_v1.3.pdf (incident response plan, redacted)
- SIG_evidence_manifest.xlsx (evidence inventory)
- caiq-crosswalk.md (CAIQ mapping)
- network-diagram-highlevel.svg (non-sensitive diagram)

Let me know if you want me to include a brief cover note for procurement.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Security Operations | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com
